top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a complete, mature discovery chain: Holst on the incretin effect and GLP-1 secretion, Drucker on proglucagon processing and peptide actions, and Mojsov on the bioactive truncated peptide. The mechanism is validated in large independent outcome trials and the allocation fits three names. The attribution risk (Habener, contested priority, Knudsen outside the trio) is real but does not outweigh an award, so no award ranks below it.
